bias.en: Pullback deepens · lost the 100-day, at the 200-day
bias.zh: 回调加深 · 跌破 100 日均线，位于 200 日均线

read.en: Palantir fell 9.7% on Nov 5 to $154.99, trading between $152.60 and $167.25 on heavy volume. It closed below the rising 100-day ($164.0), just above the rising 200-day ($153.6), and under the falling 5-day ($172.9), 10-day ($185.2) and 30-day ($191.8) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($192.61), and RSI is 25.
read.zh: Palantir 11月5日下跌 9.7%，收于 $154.99，盘中区间 $152.60–167.25，成交量放大。收盘跌破上行的 100 日均线（$164.0），略高于上行的 200 日均线（$153.6），并位于下行的 5 日（$172.9）、10 日（$185.2）和 30 日均线（$191.8）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$192.61），RSI 为 25。

read.en: The close broke the $163.8–165.3 support (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 4 lows), which had held for two days, and the $158.3 Aug 5 low; the $152.6 low tested the $152.7–153.6 zone (Aug 6 low, 200-day) and held on the close. Resistance is $156.3–158.3 (April and March highs, Aug 5 low), then $164–165.3 and $172.9 (5-day). Support is $152.6–153.6, then $148.6–149.1 (March lows). A close above $158.3 would target $164–165; below $152.6, $149.
